name: SIA 852 地面车堵滑行道 前轮爆胎

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is SIA 852, you are at Wuhan Airport, stand 7, received ATIS M, request ATC clearance to Singapore.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 SIA 852，在武汉机场 7 号机位，已收到 ATIS M，请求前往新加坡的 ATC 放行许可。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Delivery, SIA 852, stand 7, information M, request clearance to Singapore.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉放行，SIA 852，7 号机位，收到 M 情报，申请前往新加坡的放行许可。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18 左，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to Singapore via flight planned route, follow ZF-03 departure, initial climb to 1800 meters, cruising level 10400 meters, Runway 18L, departure frequency 124.7, squawk 4615, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 许可按飞行计划航路飞往新加坡，执行 ZF-03 离场，初始爬升至 1800 米，巡航高度 10400 米，跑道 18L，离场频率 124.7，应答机 4615，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: Now you are ready for push back and start up, contact Wuhan Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你准备好推出和开车，联系武汉地面。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, ready for push back and start up.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，准备好推出和开车。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, push back and start up at your own discretion.
cards.referenceText: Push back and start up at our own discretion, SIA 852.

cards.audioText: B: You have completed the push back and start up procedures. You decide to make an intersection departure from E2, contact Ground to request intersection departure from E2.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你已完成推出和开车程序。你决定从 E2 交叉口离场，联系地面请求从 E2 交叉口离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, push back and start up completed, request intersection departure from E2.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，推出和开车完成，请求从 E2 交叉口离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18 左外等待。
cards.referenceText: Intersection departure from E2 is approved, taxi to E2 via A6, A2, hold short of Runway 18L, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: E2 交叉口离场批准，经 A6、A2 滑行至 E2，跑道 18L 外等待，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: B: During taxiing you find a vehicle broken down on taxiway A, you have stopped the aircraft, inform ATC about the situation and request airport services to tow away the vehicle.
cards.audioTextZh: B：滑行期间，你发现一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，你已停止飞机，通知 ATC 情况，并请求机场服务将车辆拖走。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, a vehicle has broken down on taxiway A, we have to stop our aircraft and request airport service to tow the vehicle away.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，一辆车在 A 滑行道上故障，我们必须停止飞机，请求机场服务将车辆拖走。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, roger, hold at present position, RAM services will be assume in a few minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: C：SIA 852，收到，在当前位置等待，RAM 服务几分钟后会处理。
cards.referenceText: Hold at present position, roger, SIA 852.

cards.audioText: B: You are now holding short of Runway 18L on E2, request departure.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你在 E2 上跑道 18 左外等待，请求离场。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, holding short of Runway 18L on E2, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，在 E2 上跑道 18L 外等待，准备好离场。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, cleared for takeoff Runway 18L.
B: During the takeoff role, your nose will run over a sharp object on the runway surface and the nose wheel tire burst, you aborted the takeoff, notify Wuhan Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: B：起飞滑跑期间，你的前轮压过跑道表面的尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，你中断起飞，通知武汉塔台。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, SIA 852, our nose wheel has run over a sharp object on the runway, the tire got burst, we aborted takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，SIA 852，我们的前轮压过跑道上的尖锐物，轮胎爆胎，我们中断起飞。

cards.audioText: B: Inform ATC about the situation and request fire trucks and maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: B：通知 ATC 情况，并请求消防车和维修。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, we have run over a sharp object, and our nose wheel tire got burst, request fire service and maintenance.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，我们压过尖锐物，前轮轮胎爆胎，请求消防和维修。

cards.audioText:
C: SIA 852, roger, do you require anything else?
B: Tell the ATC that you require a tug to tow your aircraft back to the apron after inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：SIA 852，收到，你还需要其他什么吗？
B：告诉 ATC 检查后你需要牵引车将飞机拖回停机坪。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, request a tug to tow us back to the apron after inspection, SIA 852.
cards.referenceTextZh: 肯定，请求检查后用牵引车将我们拖回停机坪，SIA 852。

cards.audioText: C: SIA 852, tug is on the way.
B: Request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: B：请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Ground, SIA 852, request passenger stairs and shuttle bus to be ready at the apron.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉地面，SIA 852，请求客梯和摆渡车在停机坪准备好。
